title: Canonical single pullback and the derived counit
statement: Let B be a symmetric closed monoidal Grothendieck abelian coefficient category with additive tensor and functorial flat resolutions, let v:X′→X be a scheme morphism, U its exact inverse image, and L a B-valued etale sheaf on X. Let e be exactly singleFunctorObjIsoQh, γ exactly singleFunctorCompLeftDerivedUpperStarIso, ε the left derived counit, q,q′ the homotopy quotients, s degree-zero cochain inclusion, and c the single/termwise-U comparison. Then LU(e(L).hom);ε(q(sL));Qh(q′(c(L).hom)) = γ(L).hom;e(UL).hom. No flatness assumption on U or L is required. Inverse image is that of [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact] and the derived and single functors are those of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

proof.text: Express ε through leftDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory_hom_fac and use the naturality of that exact-functor comparison to move e(L). Expand the definitions of mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh and mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor. Cancel the mapped inverse and forward quotient/Qh comparison components. The comparison for the homotopy quotient has identity components, whose Qh image is an identity. Naturality of the inverse quotient/Qh comparison moves Qh(q′c) to the cochain localization. The remaining composite is exactly γ(L) followed by e(UL).

theorem singleFunctorObjIsoQh_pullback_counit
    {X' : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}} (v : X' ⟶ X)
    (L : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology B) :
    (upperStar B v).leftDerivedFunctor.map (singleFunctorObjIsoQh L).hom ≫
      (upperStar B v).leftDerivedFunctorCounit.app
        ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj
          ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).obj L)) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).map
        ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex (upperStar B v)
          (.up ℤ) 0).hom.app L)) =
      (singleFunctorCompLeftDerivedUpperStarIso B v).hom.app L ≫
        (singleFunctorObjIsoQh ((upperStar B v).obj L)).hom
